source.archive: Cui, Li, and Zhou OSF replication archive
source.source_article: Fehr et al. (2019), The role of moral decoupling in unethical pro-organizational behavior
authorized_normalizations: Cleared the automatic image flag as a false positive caused by the phrase company image.
Separated supervisor UPB and moral-decoupling factors.

design.primary_estimand: [E(Y|high supervisor UPB,high decoupling)-E(Y|low supervisor UPB,high decoupling)]-[E(Y|high supervisor UPB,low decoupling)-E(Y|low supervisor UPB,low decoupling)]

population.simulation_target: Operations manager deciding whether to continue a legally permitted but soon-to-be-banned chemical

materials.participant_role: Act as the operations manager in the scenario. Make your own decision and do not analyze the experiment.
materials.common_scenario: Your company uses a cheap pesticide chemical that remains legal but will soon be banned because of health risks. Your supervisor's conduct and evaluation standard are described below.

high_upb_high_decoupling.label: High Upb High Decoupling
high_upb_high_decoupling.stimulus: The supervisor has taken dishonest pro-company actions and says that putting the company first matters. The supervisor evaluates job performance separately from ethical conduct.

high_upb_low_decoupling.label: High Upb Low Decoupling
high_upb_low_decoupling.stimulus: The supervisor has taken dishonest pro-company actions and says that putting the company first matters. The supervisor evaluates both job performance and ethical conduct.

low_upb_high_decoupling.label: Low Upb High Decoupling
low_upb_high_decoupling.stimulus: The supervisor emphasizes ethical transparency and says that putting ethics first matters. The supervisor evaluates job performance separately from ethical conduct.

low_upb_low_decoupling.label: Low Upb Low Decoupling
low_upb_low_decoupling.stimulus: The supervisor emphasizes ethical transparency and says that putting ethics first matters. The supervisor evaluates both job performance and ethical conduct.

materials.response_instruction: Rate every item from 1 (strongly disagree) to 7 (strongly agree) and return only integer responses.

items.text: I would continue using the chemical.
I would keep using the chemical while it remains available.
I plan to keep using the chemical for as long as I can.
The supervisor distorts facts to benefit the company.
The supervisor takes questionable actions for the company.
The supervisor puts company interests first even unethically.
The supervisor misrepresents information for the company.
The supervisor protects the company through improper conduct.
Job performance can be evaluated apart from morality.
Ethical conduct should not affect performance evaluation.
Performance and ethics are separate judgments.
A person's work can be good despite unethical conduct.
Moral judgments can be set aside when judging performance.

research_restricted.aligned_hypothesis_text: Supervisor UPB increases employee UPB more under high than low moral decoupling.
research_restricted.reversed_hypothesis_text: Supervisor UPB does not increase employee UPB more under high than low moral decoupling.
